findings.rule: D43 / 273-c8-c10: cancel and every failure show the cancelled toast with Retry, and only then
findings.trigger: The toast is driven by persistent state (LaunchedEffect(uiState)), not a one-shot event. (a) Synchronous failure: in a prod build with an incomplete FirebaseConfig, RemoteSignInGateway.kt:34 returns NotConfigured without suspending (also CredentialManagerGoogleSource.kt:30 when there is no foreground activity). Tap Continue: the toast shows. Tap Retry: TmrToastHost dismisses the toast, then onContinueWithGoogle runs Cancelled->SigningIn->Cancelled inline on Main.immediate (SignInViewModel.kt:26,35). The StateFlow collector only ever sees Cancelled, so the LaunchedEffect key never changes and no toast appears. The user sees nothing happen. The same applies to tapping Continue again after a cancel. (b) Config change: cancel, wait for the toast to time out, then rotate or change dark mode or font size. The new composition re-runs LaunchedEffect with the retained Cancelled state and shows 'Sign-in cancelled' again without a new attempt.
findings.title: Cancelled toast keyed on state: silent Retry on a synchronous failure, and the toast replays after rotation
findings.proof: In SignInRouteTest.retryTapCallsSignInTwiceTotal (synchronous ScriptedSignInGateway), add composeRule.onNodeWithText("Sign-in cancelled. Nothing was saved.").assertIsDisplayed() after the Retry tap. It fails today because the toast was dismissed and never re-shown.
